versions.title: La Divina Liturgia di S. Giovanni Crisostomo: edition for the faithful
versions.date_role: original publication or authorial cover/preface date; no actual-use date inferred
versions.finding: Direct original image inspection: PDF/printed p. 3 names the Eparchy of Lungro, 1999 and Greek transliteration with Albanian and Italian for the faithful. P. 4 names the diocesan liturgical commission, states general ecclesiastical approval and gives MIT, Cosenza, 1999. No approving person, dated decree or protocol is identified there. Notes/drawings credit Gogol's Palermo 1972 volume; icons credit Nikos Iannakakis. PP. 34–35 show the liturgy opening; pp. 114–115 carry feast-specific dismissals and Holy Week distinctions; p. 143 is the contents index. No exact Greek exemplar, textual relation to the Roma 1967 or reported 1968 printing, actual parish implementation, Piana/Grottaferrata reception or complete source-language collation is established.

versions.title: Liturgjia Hyjnore: Nilo Somma musical setting
versions.date_role: original publication or authorial cover/preface date; no actual-use date inferred
versions.finding: Original PDF pp. 1–3 directly inspected as images: the cover identifies music by Nilo Somma and the Pontifical Seminary Benedetto XV at Grottaferrata, 4 December 1973. The preface repeats the date and describes a musical experiment following approval of a first common Albanian Chrysostom translation; that translation's exact printing, approval instrument and Greek exemplar are unnamed. Its hope of future singing by seminarians and Lungro/Piana faithful is not an actual-use attestation. P. 3 shows notated music. No complete musical/source-language collation, earlier-book identity, dated local adoption, substantive recension or history edge is established.

versions.title: Liturgjia Hyjnore e Atit tonë ndër Shejtrat Joan Hrysostomit: Greek–Albanian Roma 1967 setting
versions.finding: The exact offered scan has 92 two-up spread images. PDF p. 2 has the Greek/Albanian title and ROMA 1967, opposite a Chrysostom frontispiece. P. 3 has a general Greek Holy See approval/permission formula, without a dated approving instrument or protocol in that leaf. P. 24 shows the Chrysostom liturgy opening; pp. 31 and 33 show Sunday/feast alternatives and priest/deacon rubrics, not an annual calendar. P. 91 visibly carries printed pp. 180–181. P. 92 gives completion of printing on 15 December 1967 at the Tipografia Italo-Orientale S. Nilo of the Exarchic Monastery of S. Maria, Grottaferrata. These title and colophon facts identify this setting. They do not establish that every retrospective 1968 printing reference is this same edition, authenticate a particular Lungro receiving copy, identify the Greek exemplar, settle 6 August/13 October 1968 decree roles or establish adoption outside Lungro. Selected image inspection and whole-file acquisition do not establish physical completeness or complete literal collation. The date field records completion of printing, not adoption, approval, circulation or observed use.
